findings: `animate-gradient-shift` no-op on Home CTA — The CTA section uses `bg-size-200 animate-gradient-shift` but `bg-size-200` is not a standard Tailwind utility and no custom CSS rule sets `background-size: 200%` on that element, so the gradient shift animation silently does nothing. Fix: add `.bg-size-200 { background-size: 200% 200%; }` to style.css, or add `style="background-size:200% 200%"` inline on the element. (Confidence: confirmed)
